description: This source file defines the CachedMessageBlock class, which manages a tightly packed buffer of CachedMessage objects for efficient message caching in streaming scenarios. It provides methods for adding, removing, and querying cached messages, as well as for accessing sequence tokens and searching messages within the block.

classes.name: CachedMessageBlock
classes.description: A block of cached messages that supports adding, removing, and querying messages efficiently within a fixed size buffer.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes the oldest message (from the start) in the block, advancing the read index.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new CachedMessage to the end of the block, throws if the block is full.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Provides access to a cached message at a specific index within the valid range.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence token for a specific message by index using a data adapter.

methods.name: GetNewestSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence token of the newest message in the block.

methods.name: GetOldestSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence token of the oldest message in the block.

methods.name: GetIndexOfFirstMessageLessThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Finds the index of the first message with a sequence token less than or equal to the provided token.

methods.name: TryFindFirstMessage
methods.description: Tries to find the first message in the block matching a specific stream ID.

methods.name: TryFindNextMessage
methods.description: Tries to find the next message with a specific stream ID starting from a given index.

methods.name: OnResetState
methods.description: Resets internal indices, used by resource pooling mechanisms.
